name: whale-hunter
description: Whale Hunter. Finds the decision makers and pitches them. Looks up who signs the check, who owns the budget and who feels the pain at a company you want as a customer, using public business sources only, then writes a short pitch to the right person: what they pay today, the demo, and one small ask. Every email waits for your yes and goes out from your own account, with the legal footer and a plain way to opt out. Use when the user says "who decides at X", "find the decision maker", "find the CFO", "pitch them", "write the pitch", "cold email the buyer", "go after this company", or "hunt whales".
